verdict.rationale: Stripe's seller docs say agent orders appear on the Dashboard Transactions page tagged with the originating agent and can be filtered by agent name, which covers the core attribution and filtering. The programmatic attribution field (`PaymentIntent.agent_details`) is only in private preview, and there is no evidence of per-agent reporting or analytics beyond Dashboard filtering, so the story is only partly covered. missing for 10: generally available API-level agent attribution (agent_details is private preview), documented per-agent reporting/analytics or exports beyond Dashboard filtering, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, orders are attributed to the originating agent and I can report on or filter transactions by agent

citations.quote: where they’re tagged with the originating agent
You can also filter transactions by agent names.
